description: Source code for a file merging and diffing library, specifically implementing multi-way merge logic with conflict resolution and refinement functions.

classes.name: xdmerge_t
classes.description: Structure representing a merge hunk, including conflict mode and line ranges.

methods.name: xdl_append_merge
methods.description: Appends a merge hunk to the list, merging overlapping hunks if necessary.

methods.name: xdl_cleanup_merge
methods.description: Frees merge hunks and counts conflicts.

methods.name: xdl_merge_cmp_lines
methods.description: Compares lines from two environments for equality.

methods.name: xdl_recs_copy_0
methods.description: Copies a range of records from environment to buffer, optionally adding newline and CR.

methods.name: xdl_recs_copy
methods.description: Copies records from environment to buffer.

methods.name: xdl_orig_copy
methods.description: Copies original records from environment to buffer.

methods.name: is_eol_crlf
methods.description: Determines if a line ends with CRLF, LF, or indeterminate.

methods.name: is_cr_needed
methods.description: Decides if CR should be used based on surrounding lines.

methods.name: fill_conflict_hunk
methods.description: Generates conflict marker blocks for conflicting regions.

methods.name: xdl_fill_merge_buffer
methods.description: Constructs the merged output buffer from merge hunks.

methods.name: recmatch
methods.description: Checks if two records match based on flags.

methods.name: xdl_refine_zdiff3_conflicts
methods.description: Refines conflicts by removing common prefix/suffix lines.

methods.name: xdl_refine_conflicts
methods.description: Refines conflicts by diffing and minimizing conflict regions.

methods.name: line_contains_alnum
methods.description: Checks if a line contains alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: lines_contain_alnum
methods.description: Checks if any line in a range contains alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: xdl_merge_two_conflicts
methods.description: Merges two adjacent conflict hunks into one.

methods.name: xdl_simplify_non_conflicts
methods.description: Simplifies non-conflicting regions by merging small hunks.

methods.name: xdl_do_merge
methods.description: Performs the core three-way merge, handling conflicts and refinement.

methods.name: xdl_merge
methods.description: Public API for merging two files with a common ancestor, producing a merged result.
